question: What Scopes does the Atlas define, and what does each one govern? Name one key responsibility per Scope.
answer:
The Atlas defines six Scopes:

- **The Governance Scope** [The Governance Scope](/atlas/18ac7dd3-c646-4352-9b0d-d01a2932d7d1) — regulates the governance processes and balance of power of the Sky Ecosystem, ensuring the resilient equilibrium of Sky Governance remains protected against threats.
- **The Support Scope** [The Support Scope](/atlas/1ce14bd8-c7b3-4f74-a152-292a8d8ebed0) — governs routine aspects of ecosystem support, including governance process infrastructure management and Agent/Ecosystem Actor support.
- **The Stability Scope** [The Stability Scope](/atlas/d56538fc-2220-491a-a4d2-7ad6e461d707) — governs the management of the USDS Stablecoin, including its stability and risk.
- **The Protocol Scope** [The Protocol Scope](/atlas/5c20d9af-0bb9-4ca1-a944-1e2cb6f8bb6b) — regulates the maintenance and development of the core Sky Protocol and its critical, non-collateral components.
- **The Accessibility Scope** [The Accessibility Scope](/atlas/99b1b47d-3c7a-4859-ac00-8c0849f9070e) — governs accessibility and distribution efforts, and regulates user-facing frontends.
- **The Agent Scope** [The Agent Scope](/atlas/4a08ca6c-e652-49e4-9b79-4831b20e600a) — regulates all Agents within the Sky Ecosystem and comprises all Agent Artifacts.
